answer: Give every agent exactly one work orchard: a bundle of re-runnable tasks whose outputs are bound to that identity and may not be reused by any other key. Voting weight does not appear at signup; it waits on a holding ledge until several unrelated peers re-execute the same outputs and countersign them. Only then does weight advance like a glacier, adding a little each epoch the orchard stays unique and unchallenged. Recycled outputs collapse the whole cluster and burn every copy's deposit, so a majority cannot be assembled inside a single window.
